accepted.reason: Abstract-base false positive: requestPaid is a default-false mapping and is set by the concrete TreasuryPilotModule.pay before interaction. TreasuryPilotGovernance is abstract and cannot be deployed as a module.
activeFrom == 0 is the explicit never-registered sentinel, not a financial or time threshold equality. Initialized payees always have activeFrom > 0 because cooling >= 1.
The helper intentionally reads only the healthFactor field of the fixed Pool's six-field getUserAccountData response. Remaining account values do not authorize treasury movement.
